outputs.explanation: Schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol; not a data plot.
Western blot images; raw data displayed directly, not an averaged plot.
RT-qPCR time-course plots show only mean ± SEM (n = 3–4 biological experiments per caption) for each gene; no individual data points are overlaid on the lines/error bars.
Live-imaging micrographs of EBs; not a quantitative average plot.
Flow cytometry density/dot plots display raw single-cell events directly; the underlying individual measurements are inherently shown, not just summary statistics.
Positive cell proportion curves are plotted as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) across SB/DMH1 concentrations, with no individual replicate data points shown.
Like panel F, only mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) is plotted for SOX17-Tom and NKX2-5-GFP positive cell percentages; individual data points are absent.
Immunostaining micrographs; not an averaged quantitative plot.

Standard Tukey boxplots (median, quartiles, whiskers) summarize RNA-seq counts across 8 sorted populations from only n = 3 biological replicates, but no individual data points are overlaid on the boxes.
Heatmap columns display Z-score/log2FC values for individual samples/replicates per population rather than a single averaged summary value, so individual data are already visible.
